integrity: The universal sign is proved analytically from an exact integral and a quadratic-root inequality. The bundled numerical verifier is corroborative only. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
limitations: Local second variation in the one-dimensional affine moduli of trapezoids only; no global monotonicity in the trapezoid parameter, no arbitrary-quadrilateral Hessian, and no global finite-radius extremal theorem are claimed.
title: Universal negative trapezoid second variation of finite-radius Funk–Santaló volume
